label: C
text: Where a star line crosses a side of the big figure, rule a line at right angles to the 7.5° line, and its mirror image in the horizontal; turn both round. These 24 lines make the small five-pointed stars.

label: Tg
text: Through the point of the first circle at 30°, rule the line at right angles to the 30° line: it just touches the circle. Turn it round (helper lines).

label: B
text: Where the lines touching the circle at 30° and −30° cross the horizontal, rule a line at right angles to it; turn it round. These lines close the brown pentagons.

label: G
text: Where a side of the big figure crosses one of the 24 lines, rule a line at right angles to the 22.5° line; turn it round in eighths: the octagon of the corner stars.

label: F
text: Where an octagon side crosses one of the 24 lines, rule a line at right angles to the horizontal; turn it round in quarters: the frame, and the edge of the tile.

label: D
text: Where a star line crosses one of the pentagon lines, rule a line at right angles to the horizontal, and turn it round: the inner side of the ring round the shields.

label: K
text: Where two of the 24 lines cross on the horizontal, rule a line at right angles to the 15° line; turn it round: the points of the ring round the shields.

label: S
text: Where a side of the big figure crosses one of the last-but-one set, rule a line at right angles to the horizontal; turn it round. These carry the star lines on into the corners.

label: H
text: Where the frame crosses a pentagon line, rule a line at right angles to the 45° line; turn it round in quarters: the lines across the corners.

label: M
text: Where a side of the big figure crosses a pentagon line, rule a line at right angles to the 15° line; turn it round.

label: N
text: Where two of the 24 lines cross on the 45° line, rule a line at right angles to the 15° line; turn it round.
